name: second-brain
description: Local-first Second Brain for Claude Code: capture, ingest, find, link, update and lint a plain-markdown vault with a deterministic CLI, protective hooks and optional local auto-commit.

auto_commit.title: Auto-commit vault changes
auto_commit.description: At the end of each session, commit vault changes locally when the vault has a .git directory. Never pushes.

recall.title: Recall vault notes on each prompt
recall.description: Before each prompt, search the vault and add up to five possibly relevant note summaries to the context.
